summary_en: NSD raised its FY2027 March year-end dividend forecast from 97 yen to 100 yen per share, a 4 yen increase from the prior year, reflecting upward revision of full-year earnings guidance and adherence to its capital allocation policy of dividend payout ratio of 50% or more and total shareholder return ratio of 70% or more. The payout ratio is projected at 56.7% and total return ratio at 71.6%.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision (Increase) of FY2027 March Year-End Dividend Forecast
translation_en_brief:
On September 28, 2026, NSD announced a revision to its FY2027 March year-end dividend forecast. The company raised its per-share dividend from 97 yen to 100 yen, increasing the total dividend for the fiscal year from 97 yen to 100 yen per share. This marks a 4 yen increase compared to the prior fiscal year FY2026 March (which was 96 yen).

The increase reflects two main drivers: an upward revision of the full-year earnings guidance announced on the same day, and the company's capital allocation policy requiring a dividend payout ratio of 50% or more and a total shareholder return ratio of 70% or more, both on a consolidated basis. Under this revised forecast, the payout ratio for FY2027 is expected to reach 56.7%, while the total return ratio is projected at 71.6%, both complying with the stated policy thresholds.
